decision: Keep primary product categories indexable and treat product tags and filtered URLs as review-required before indexation.
rationale: The site has commercial category pages but weak tag and filtered URL content. Final handling depends on rendered canonical, robots and sitemap output.
confirmed_evidence: Source-register rows queued for Yoast WooCommerce SEO verification
assumptions: Product categories have unique copy and internal links
Product tags are currently thin or duplicated
risks: Indexing weak product tags can create low-value duplicate archive URLs
Changing archive visibility without QA can create sitemap/noindex conflicts
implementation_notes: Confirm taxonomy quality before making indexation changes in Yoast settings or filters.
qa_required: Check rendered canonical and meta robots on product categories and tags
Check XML sitemap inclusion for product and product taxonomy URLs
Check a representative filtered URL for crawl/index behaviour
review_trigger: Review after WooCommerce taxonomy changes, product import, or Yoast WooCommerce SEO upgrade.
